title: Atmospheric methane
summary: Methane's concentration, growth, budget and warming effect, and what drives them.

concepts.label: Methane
concepts.description: CH₄, a greenhouse gas with an atmospheric lifetime of about 9 years.

children.label: Mole fraction
children.description: Parts per billion of dry air, global marine surface average (NOAA).

children.label: Growth rate
children.description: The increase over a year, ppb/yr.

children.label: Methane emissions
children.description: Tg CH₄ per year from wetlands, agriculture, waste, fossil fuels and fires; here inferred in one box.

children.label: Hydroxyl radical
children.description: OH, the atmosphere's detergent: it destroys about 90% of methane.

children.label: Radiative forcing
children.description: The change in the Earth's energy balance (W/m²) since 1750.

concepts.label: El Niño–Southern Oscillation
concepts.description: The Pacific's warm (El Niño) and cool (La Niña) swings, measured by the Oceanic Niño Index.
